rust_summary: `native_block_entity_tag(dimension, pos)`: the data of a block entity in any loaded level, as the block entity's save without its id and position.
doc_summary: `native_block_entity_tag(dimension, pos)` gives the data of the block entity at `pos` in the loaded level `dimension` as the server saves it (`BlockEntity.saveWithoutMetadata`: no id, no position), or None when there is none or the level isn't loaded (also on a client). Read-only. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_entity_tag@.
